verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents its own Zapier integration that connects mail to 5000+ apps, plus an API, which points toward event-driven automation. However, nothing in the evidence names a 'new mail' or 'scan completed' trigger, and there are no registrable outbound webhooks. The only push-style notification mentioned is email alerts, which don't qualify as webhooks. Missing for 10: documented outbound webhooks with registration and payloads, explicit Zapier triggers for new-mail and scan-complete events, published API/event docs (probes found no OpenAPI spec), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I get webhooks (or at least Zapier triggers) when new mail arrives or a scan completes, so downstream automation starts without polling
